selection: Choose a catalog workflow by task kind; explain selection and each omitted optional stage. Mandatory stages and order cannot change.
execution: Only the current stage may launch. Run its real action, then every configured verifier. Failed verification cannot complete a stage or launch a successor.
loop: Repair and rerun the current stage under fixed attempt and wall-clock limits. Without a repair command return needs-rework for Agent correction. Unchanged failed inputs cannot be blindly retried. Preserve prior successful stages only while their full input fingerprints still match.
display: Render workflow id/name/version, current stage and every selected stage from the actual durable state; no manually supplied display text.
